newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Trust to insure HIV positive people - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Trust to insure HIV positive people - NYT.

text.p: Midwestern insurance company Guarantee Trust Life Insurance plans had started offering life insurance to some people who were HIV positive, the New York Times said on Wednesday.
For the first 90 days, sales would be limited to Illinois, where the company was based, the newspaper said.
The firm planned to expand across the United States once they could assess demand, the Times said.

"We believe many otherwise healthy HIV-positive individuals are more appropriately viewed as having a treatable chronic illness rather than a terminal disease," company president Richard Holson III was quoted as saying.
